items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: He was a very, very fine musician. And I think Fazzola was one of his... He was Fazzola's idol.

ctx.x: Bill Bourgeois. And Florence, what's your name? You're taking pictures here. Florence, Florence. And I'm Dick Allen. Okay, let's see. We were just playing that Bosdell for a record of... Let's see, what was that? Waffle Man's Call? Waffle Man's Call. That's pretty old, isn't it? Yeah, 24, I think. And you said... That's about the year I started playing. Yeah, is that right? And you were saying he was good with the plunging music, huh?
Very, very good. He was excellent. And Skaggs, you say?
Skagg Leone, yeah. And what about him? We were talking about him and Fass, huh?
